paite: Huan Joab ahilh ua, "Ngai in, kumpipa’n kap in Absalom asuun hi," achi uh.
heading: Joab In David Amohsa

paite: Huai ni a avualzohna uh mi tengteng a ding in suunna ahong hi zawta hi. "Atapa ziak in kumpipa alungkham mahmah," achih uh huai ni in mite'n lah ana zata ngal ua.
Mite kidouna a mi taimang azum ziak a aguk a paimang bang in huai ni in aguk in khopi ah alut uhi.
Kumpipa'n amai ahum a, "Aw, ka tapa Absalom, aw Absalom, ka tapa, ka tapa!" chi in kumpipa akap huphup hi.
Inn ah kumpipa kiang ah Joab alut a, "Na hinna, na tapate hinna, na tanute hinna, na zite leh na meite hinna humbit mite tuni in zumtak in na bawlta hi.

Nang hon hote na it a, nang hon itte na hua hi. Heutute leh sepaihte nang a dia bangmah hilou bang in tuni in na hihlangta hi. Absalom dam in, kou midang tengteng tuni in si zaw vek le ung, na kipah lamtak hileh kilawm in ka thei hi.

Huaiziak in thou inla, pawtkhia in. Na mite lungmuansak ding lam thu gen in. Na pawtkhiak keileh TOUPA min lou in ka kichiam hi. Mi khat lel leng tuzan in na kiang ah a-om kei ding. Huai lah nang a ding in na tuailai a pan tutan a na tung a thil hoih lou hong tung teng sang in ahoih kei zaw ding," achi hi.

Huchi in kumpipa athou a, kulh kongpi ah ava tu hi. "Ngai un, kumpipa kulh kongpi ah atu hi,” chi in mipi tengteng ahilh uhi. Mipi tengteng kumpipa ma ah ava hoh uhi. Israelte bel amau puanin chiat ah ataikek uhi.
Israel nam a mi tengteng akisel vengvung ua, "Kumpipa'n i melmate khut a pan hon hunkhia a, Philistiate khut a pan hon hondamta. Tu in Absalom ziak in gam ataikhiaksan hi.
heading: Jerusalem Ah David Akiknawn

paite: Absalom i kumpipa dia thau i nilhpa uh lah kidouna ah asita a; bang achia kumpipa pikikna ding kam khat bek na gen louh uh?" akichi uh.

Kumpipa'n siampu Zadok leh Abiathar kiang ah asawl a, Judah upate kiang ah, "Bangziak a kumpipa a-inn a pikik thu a, azekaipen a pang na hi ua? Israel mite'n kumpipa pikik thu agen uh lah kumpipa kiang atungta ngal a.
Ка unaute na hi ua, ka guh leh ka sa lah na hi ngal ua, bang achia azekaipen a pang peuhmah na hi ua? chi in va gen un,” achi hi.

Amasa kiang ah, "Ka guh leh ka sa na hi kei a hia? Joab sik a ka ma a sepaihte heutu a ka hon bawl keileh, Pathian in alohloh hon loh mai henla, huai sang a thupizaw in leng, achi," chi ding in mi asawl hi.
Huchi in Judah mi tengteng lungtang mi khat lungtang bang mai in a-awnsakta hi. Huchi in kumpipa kiang ah, "Na mi tengteng toh hong kik nawn un," chi ding in mi asawl uhi.
Huchi in kumpipa apai nawn a, Jordan ahong tung hi. Kumpipa dawn a, Jordan a na pi galkai ding in Gilgal ah Judahte ahoh uhi.
Hahurim a Benjamin mi Gera tapa Shimei leng kintak in kumpipa dawn ding in Judahte mah toh kiton in apawtkhia hi.
Akiang ah Benjamin mi sangkhat toh, Saul inkote sikha Ziba, atapa sawm-le-nga leh asikha sawmnih toh ahi ua, kumpipa ma in Jordan agalkah uhi.
Kumpipa inkote pi galkahna ding leh hoih asak bangbang a hih ding in long apaipih uh. Jordan lui agalkahleh kumpipa ma ah Gera tapa Shimei abokkhup hi.

Kumpipa kiang ah, "Ka toupa'n thulimlouhna nei in hon sep kei henla; toupa ka kumpipa'n Jerusalem apawtsan ni a na sikha in dikloutak a ana hihte leng theigige sam kei hen. Kumpipa'n alungtang ah pai kei hen.
heading: David In Shimei Tung ah Itna Alangsak

paite: Na sikha in thil ka hihkhial chih ka kithei hi. Huaiziak in ngai in, Joseph inko tengteng lak a ka toupa kumpipa mu dia tuni a hong pawt masapen ka hi," achi hi.
Himahleh Zeruiah tapa Abishai in adawng a, "TOUPA thaunilhpa ahamsiat ziak in Shimei pen thah ding ahi kei dia hia?" achi hi.

David in, "Nou Zeruiah tapate aw, nou na hon na theihsak ding uh bang ahia om? Tuni a kei hon doute na hi ding uh maw? Tuni a Israelte lak a mi thah ahi dia hia? Tuni in Israel mite tung a kumpipa ka hihthei lou ka hi maw?" achi hi.
Huaiziak in kumpipa'n Shimei kiang ah, "Na si kei ding," achi hi. Huchi in Kumpipa akiang ah akichiamta hi.
Kumpipa mu ding in Saul tapa Mephibosheth ahong hi. Kumpipa apawtkhiak ni a pan galmuang a ahong pai nawn ni tan in akhete azun kei a, akhamul atan kei a, apuan leng asawp sam kei.
heading: David In Mephibosheth Itna A-ensak

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa mu dia Jerusalem ahong tun in kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Mephibosheth, bangziak a ka kiang a hong sam lou?" achi hi.
Ama'n adawng a, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, ka sikha in ahon khem a; na sikha in, kumpipa kiang a hoh ding in ka tuanna ding sabiltung ka van ding, ka chi a; na sikha lah akhe abai ngal a.
Kumpipa ka toupa kiang ah na sikha ahek hi. Himahleh toupa ka kumpipa Pathian angel ahi. Huaiziak in hoih na sak bangbang in hih in.

Ka pa inkote tengteng toupa ka kumpipa ma a thah vek dia kilawm ahi uh. Himahleh na sikha na an umpihte lak ah na pangsak hi. Huaiziak in kumpipa kiang ah thil dang phut ngam lai dia kilawm ka hi maw?" achi hi.
Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Na tungtang thu bangziak a gen nawn nak na hia? Nang leh Ziba gam kihawm un ka chi hi,” achi hi.
Mephibosheth in kumpipa kiang ah, "Eh, ama'n tang vek hen, toupa ka kumpipa lah ama inn mah ah galmuang in ahong pai nawnta ngal a,” achi hi.
Rogelim a pan Gilead mi Barzillai ahong suk a; kumpipa Jordan a pi galkai ding in amah toh Jordan ah ahoh hi.
heading: David In Barzillai Tung Ah Itna Alangsak

paite: Barzillai upapi ahi a, kum sawmgiat a upa ahita. Mahanaim a kumpipa om sung in nek ding apia a, amah mineizoutak ahi.
Kumpipa'n Barzillai kiang ah, "Ka kiang ah hong inla, ka kiang ah Jerusalem ah ka hon vak ding," achi hi.
Barzillai in kumpipa kiang ah, "Jerusalem a kumpipa toh hohtou ding in bang tan ka dam lai dia?

Tu in kum sawmgiat ka hita a; asia leh apha ka khen thei a hia? Na sikha in ka nek-le-dawn, a lim leh lim louh leng a theikak thei a hia? Pasal leh numeite lasak ging leng ka za thei nawn a hia? Huaiziak in na sikha bang ding a toupa ka kumpipa a dia puakgik ka hih maizen ding?
Na sikha in kumpipa toh Jordan galkah lel ka tup ahi. Bang ding in kumpipa'n huchibang in hoih man ahon thuk chitchiat dia?

Hehpih in na sikha hon paisak nawn mai in, ka hon ngen ahi. Ka nu leh ka pa han omna koumau kho ngei ah ka si ding. Himahleh en in, na sikha Chimham; toupa ka kumpipa toh hong galkah henla, atung ah hoih na sak bangbang in hih in,” achi hi.
Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Chimham ka kiang ah agalkah sam dia, hoih na sak bang zel in atung ah ka hih ding. Thil na hon nget peuhmah ka hon hihsak ding," achi hi.
Huchi in mi tengteng Jordan gal akah ua, kumpipa leng agalkah hi. Kumpipa'n Barzillai atawp a, avualzawl hi. Huchi in amah amun ah apai nawnta hi.
Huchi in Gilgal ah kumpipa agalkah a, amah toh Chimham agalkah sam hi. Juda mi tengteng in kumpipa api galkah ua, Israel mi leng akimkhat apang uhi.
heading: Judah Leh Israel Kumpipa Tungtang Ah Akisel Uh

paite: Ngai in, Israel mi tengteng kumpipa kiang ah ahong ua, kumpipa kiang ah, "Bang achia ka unau uh Judah mite'n nang hon gukhia a, kumpipa leh a-inkote leh David mite teng Jordan gal a apikhawm vek mawk uh?" achi uhi.

Judah mi tengteng in Israel mite adawng ua, "Kumpipa ka kinaihpih uh ahih ziak ahi. Bangziak a hiai thu a heh mawk? Kumpipa neih muang a om ka hi mahmah uh maw? Thilpiak banghiamte leng ahon nei a hia?" achi uh.

Israel mite'n Judah mite adawng ua, "Kumpipa ah tan sawm ka nei ua, David ah noute sang in anglaitanna ka nei zaw uh. Bangziak a hon ngaineu maw? Kumpipa pikik nawn sawm masate ka hi kei uh maw?" achi uh. Huchi in Judah mite thu Israel mite thu sang in akhauhzaw hi.
